name: superstables
description: Find paid services, use budgets, and request single purchases you approve. Testnet only.

interface.shortDescription: Find paid services, use budgets, and request single purchases you approve. Testnet only.
interface.longDescription: Superstables lets your agent find services that charge per request and read what they cost. In an app with a terminal, Budgets let you approve a total spending limit in your wallet, on your machine or on superstables.com. The agent can then spend within that limit without approval for each purchase. You can revoke the budget by signing a transaction in your wallet. For a single purchase through the connector, an account member approves and signs in their wallet on superstables.com before payment. Testnet only: test tokens, no real money.
